provision.quote: The order has been passed under Section 73 of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

events.quote: Petitioner had filed a detailed reply dated 18.10.2023
impugned order dated 28.12.2023, whereby the impugned Show Cause Notice dated 23.09.2023, proposing a demand of Rs.55,23,524.00 against the Petitioner has been disposed of

document_contents.quote: Perusal of the Show Cause Notice shows that the Department has given separate headings i.e., excess claim Input Tax Credit [“ITC”]; under declaration of ineligible ITC and ITC claimed from cancelled dealers, return defaulters and tax nonpayers.
It merely states that “Now, since reply/explanation submitted by the taxpayer is not satisfactory.

defects_argued.quote: Proper Officer had to at least consider the reply on merits and then form an opinion whether the reply was unsatisfactory.
He merely held that the reply is not satisfactory which ex-facie shows that Proper Officer has not applied his mind to the reply submitted by the petitioner.
The challenge to Notification No. 9 of 2023 with regard to the initial extension of time is left open.

outcome.quote: Accordingly, the impugned order dated 28.12.2023 is set aside.
